sources.title: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B · Models
sources.snippet: Hy-MT2 is a family of "fast-thinking" multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B - API Pricing & Providers | OpenRouter
sources.snippet: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B is Tencent's flagship translation model in the Hy-MT2 family. $0.074 per million input tokens, $0.295 per million output tokens. 8,192 token context window, maximum output of 4,096 tokens.
